findings.explanation: The endpoint does not verify that the user deleting the account is either the owner of the account or an administrator, which violates the policy rule that a user may only delete their own account.

evidence.content:
- A user may read or update ONLY their own profile (`/users/<id>`). Administrators may read or update any profile. Use
  `is_owner_or_admin(current_user, user_id)` for this check.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a check to ensure the deleting user is either the owner of the account or an administrator using `is_owner_or_admin(current_user, user_id)`. If not, return an error with status code 403 (Forbidden).
